entries.name: Windows SDK (Win32, D2D1, DWrite, WIC, TaskSchd)
entries.justification: OS/SDK components shipped as part of Windows under the Microsoft Windows SDK licence. Not redistributed: every API resolves against the target OS at runtime, and no SDK binary is bundled into the shipped artifacts. Mandated by R-004/R-005/R-006/R-038.

entries.name: Inno Setup
entries.justification: Custom permissive build-time installer tool; not linked into or shipped with AuraLite-Defrag binaries.

entries.name: MSVC v143 / Windows SDK headers
entries.justification: Proprietary compiler and header set, used at build time only. No MSVC or SDK binary is redistributed; the resulting executable links against OS-provided DLLs. Alternative toolchains are not supported in v1.

entries.name: Python 3
entries.justification: Runs the repository audit scripts (tools/check_*.py). Permissive and GPL-compatible; build-time only, never shipped.

entries.name: MSIX SDK tools (MakeAppx/SignTool)
entries.justification: Part of the Windows SDK. Used to package and sign the installer; no MSIX runtime or SDK binary is redistributed with the product.

entries.name: Catch2 (optional, not used)
entries.justification: Optional external test framework mentioned in CMake. The repository ships its own runner and does not link Catch2 in any configuration.

entries.name: nlohmann/json (optional, not used)
entries.justification: Optional tooling dependency mentioned in CMake. The repository ships its own strict JSON parser; no nlohmann code is compiled in.
